svg.title: 323SUT lithium install layout
svg.desc: Illustrated three-quarter view of the 323SUT front basement after the lithium upgrade: two Renogy Reserve Mini 314Ah batteries strapped on a rubber mat inside wood cleats, terminals facing the door; four equal 2 ft 2/0 cables over the battery tops to two Joinfworld 400 A bus bars on a plywood board on the back wall; a MidNite MNDC250 enclosure mounted sideways beside the board with its cover off, showing the 250 A main breaker and the MNEDC40 40 A breaker, brass cable glands, cushioned clamps, and the existing RV and DRIVEN cables. Roughly to scale; compartment shape and exact positions are illustrative.
svg.text: 323SUT lithium install - how it should look
Front basement, door open · MNDC250 cover and bus bar covers off to show the wiring · roughly to scale from the parts' dimensions; exact positions to suit the compartment
MNDC250: 17 in long, mounted sideways · 9 in tall · 3.5 in deep
2 x Renogy Reserve Mini 12 V 314Ah, in parallel; terminals toward the door (7.87 in clear)
GOODTIMES, 2 per battery, across the cases and clear of the terminals
Rubber mat; wood cleats around the ~16 x 15 in footprint, screwed to solid floor
Joinfworld 400 A. Studs: 1 Battery 1 +, 2 Battery 2 +, 3 MNEDC40, 4 MNDC250
Joinfworld 400 A. Studs: 1 DRIVEN −, 2 RV main −, 3 Battery 1 −, 4 Battery 2 −
Shirbly 2/0, all four 2 ft - equal lengths so both batteries share the load
Stud 4 to the 250 A breaker's battery stud - check it reaches
17 x 9 x 3.5 in, mounted sideways; mounting holes 15.40 in apart; cover back on after
50,000 A interrupt; the bank's on/off switch; studs 220 in-lb
DRIVEN solar feed and its on/off switch; 1/4 in lugs; studs 30 in-lb
One per cable: 3/4 in + reducing washers for 2/0, 1/2 in for 8 AWG
To the red disconnect switch, 120 A OPTIFUSE and WFCO; check its lug size
ISPINNER stainless, rubber-lined; 5/8 in on 2/0, 1/4-5/16 in on 8 AWG; one screw each into the wall
Not used - all negatives go to the negative bus bar; optional wire to chassis
Two free panel-mount slots for future solar controller breakers
Both breakers + disconnect OFF · charge each battery full alone · DRIVEN set to 3.2-4 first
